name: io.github.Aaronjacobs000/sophos-mcp
description: Unofficial, not a Sophos product. MCP server for the Sophos Fusion (formerly Sophos Central) APIs.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of a Sophos Central API credential (tenant, partner or organisation).

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret that pairs with the client ID.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed to stdio. The server defaults to streamable HTTP without it.
